rows.medi_said: Uh, shu, shu ahki? Shu tehki? Shu haket li? ... haket li. Shu haket li?

rows.amal_said: Which, which one is it? [speaks Arabic]

rows.medi_said: rah yitkhar-- rah titkharabi. ... Yeah, rah titkharabi. Rah atkharabt. ... rah titkharabiha.

rows.medi_said: rah yitkhar-- rah titkharabi.
rows.amal_said: ليش؟ You would ruin it? ... one T. ... اه، راح تخربيها.
rows.why: In 'if you put too much salt in the soup you will ruin it' he left the object off the transitive verb; she prompted 'You would ruin it?', he added -ha (rah titkharabiha, 56:46), she trimmed the doubled t and confirmed راح تخربيها (56:55). The 'two T' remark is a stutter/prefix doubling, not a second row.

rows.amal_said: Yes, بس we're talking about شوربة. So... ... صح.
